stem: A farmer weighed 5 pumpkins, and their mean weight was 12 kilograms. After the farmer sold one of the pumpkins, the mean weight of the remaining 4 pumpkins was 10 kilograms. What was the weight, in kilograms, of the pumpkin that was sold?
solution: Total weight of the 5 pumpkins: \(5 \cdot 12 = 60\) kilograms.
Total weight of the remaining 4: \(4 \cdot 10 = 40\) kilograms.
verify:
w = symbols('w')
r = solve(Eq((5 * 12 - w) / 4, 10), w)[0]
assert r == 20
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == r and len(spr_answers) == 1
